block.rswirelesscrafting.charging_statio: Charges supported terminals and FE devices through 3 wired slots or wirelessly for nearby players. The buffer refills from the RS network when not full and accepts external FE input.
Wired: 3 slots, each limited to %s FE/s, with 100% charging efficiency.
Wireless: per-device limit %s FE/s, radius %s blocks, efficiency %s%%.
Wireless has 3 device slots, shared by up to 3 nearest players. One player can use all slots.
Idle drain while wireless is enabled: %s FE/s, plus charging costs.
Redstone stops wireless charging and pauses the idle drain; wired charging remains enabled.
Station energy buffer. Refills from the network when not full and accepts external FE input.

text.autoconfig.rswirelesscrafting.optio: Wireless Crafting Grid
Battery capacity and base action energy costs for the Wireless Crafting Grid.
Base battery capacity (FE)
Stored energy limit without Battery Upgrades, not the current stored energy.
Capacity per Battery Upgrade (FE)
Battery capacity added per Battery Upgrade; does not directly add stored energy.
Base opening cost (FE)
Base energy cost to open the Wireless Crafting Grid, scaled by applicable multipliers.
Base manual crafting cost (FE)
Base energy cost per manual crafting action in the Wireless Crafting Grid.
Base autocrafting submission cost (FE)
Base energy cost to submit an autocrafting task, separate from the autocrafter's machine energy usage while completing it.
Base clear matrix cost (FE)
Base energy cost to clear the Wireless Crafting Grid's crafting matrix.
Base recipe transfer cost (FE)
Base energy cost to transfer a recipe into the Wireless Crafting Grid.
Distance Energy
Distance and interdimensional energy multipliers for wireless devices.
Base range (blocks)

In the same dimension, the base multiplier is x1 within this range and grows linearly beyond it (multiplier = distance / base range). Terminals use horizontal distance, then apply relevant upgrades and amplifier effects.
Interdimensional multiplier (%)
Energy multiplier for cross-dimensional access, configured as a percentage.
Basic energy divisor
The Energy Upgrade divides the same-dimension distance multiplier by this value, with a minimum of 100%; the interdimensional multiplier is unchanged.
Terminal Charging Station
Charging rates, efficiency, idle drain and buffer configuration for the Terminal Charging Station.
Base idle drain (FE/s)
Continuous idle drain from the internal buffer while wireless is enabled, plus charging costs. Redstone pauses this drain.
Enable idle drain
When off, no idle drain is drawn; wired and wireless charging remain enabled and still consume buffer energy.
Wired charging limit (FE/s)
Charging rate limit per wired slot, distributed over 20 ticks/s; actual delivery depends on buffer energy and the device's acceptance rate.
Wireless charging limit (FE/s)
Charging rate limit per allocated device in nearby players' inventories; actual delivery depends on buffer energy, efficiency and the device's acceptance rate.
Wireless charging efficiency (%)
Share of consumed energy delivered wirelessly to the device; the rest is transmission loss. Wired charging efficiency is 100%.
Wireless charging radius (blocks)
Radius of the wireless charging area, in blocks.
Internal energy buffer capacity (FE)
Station buffer capacity, not current stored energy. Refills from the network when not full and accepts external FE input.

block.rswirelesscrafting.wireless_amplif: While active, reduces the same-dimension distance energy multiplier for covered terminals as configured; halves it by default.
Redstone pauses the amplifier effect and its operating drain.
Amplifier: %s - Horizontal radius %s blocks - Covered multiplier factor x%s

text.autoconfig.rswirelesscrafting.optio: Wireless Amplifier
Configures the same-dimension distance energy discount for covered terminals.
Enable the amplifier
When off, amplifiers stop providing their effect and drawing operating energy, and show an inactive state.
Continuous drain (FE/s)
Continuous energy drawn from the connected network while the amplifier is active.
Horizontal coverage radius (blocks)
Horizontal radius within which the amplifier effect applies, in blocks.
Covered distance multiplier factor (%)
50 halves the same-dimension distance multiplier for covered terminals; the interdimensional multiplier is unchanged.

block.rswirelesscrafting.wireless_bridge: Extends the same RS network to a distant location, including across dimensions. Chunk loading at both ends is configurable.
Unpaired: anchor. Connect it to an RS network for distant endpoints to bind to.
Paired: endpoint. When the link is connected, the network extends here and RS cables can connect.
With automatic chunk loading enabled, the endpoint requests both chunks and pays extra fees. Disabling it blocks new requests without releasing existing holds.

Use the Wireless Connector to right-click a block on the anchor's RS network, then a distant Wireless Bridge to pair. Connector clicks treat Wireless Bridges as devices, not anchors to record. With no record, right-click an endpoint to unbind; sneak-right-click only clears the record. Empty-hand sneak-right-click still records an unpaired bridge, pairs it using an existing record, or unbinds an endpoint.
Operating drain per endpoint: %s FE/s, plus chunk-loading fees.
msg.rswirelesscrafting.bridge.anchor_hin: Unpaired. Connect to an RS network and right-click another block on that network with the Wireless Connector to record an access point. Empty-hand sneak-right-click records this anchor when no record exists, or pairs it when one exists.
msg.rswirelesscrafting.bridge.offline: Link disconnected. Check the anchor network, power, permissions, configuration and chunk loading.
msg.rswirelesscrafting.bridge.anchor_set: Anchor recorded. Right-click another Wireless Bridge with the Wireless Connector to pair, or sneak-right-click an unpaired bridge with an empty hand.
msg.rswirelesscrafting.bridge.bound: Paired as an endpoint. Connection depends on the network, power, permissions and configuration.
block.rswirelesscrafting.wireless_bridge: Extra endpoint drain per held end chunk: %s FE/s.
Redstone disconnects the endpoint link and pauses its operating drain; existing chunk holds remain.
msg.rswirelesscrafting.bridge.suspended: Suspended by redstone. Existing chunk holds remain.
text.autoconfig.rswirelesscrafting.optio: Wireless Bridge
Extends the same RS network to a distant location, including across dimensions; unlike the Network Bridge, which links independent networks.
Enable the wireless bridge

When off, endpoints disconnect and pause their operating drain; existing chunk holds remain. Unbinding or removing the endpoint releases holds; after unbinding, its own chunk is released on the next update.
Operating drain per endpoint (FE/s)
Charged per running endpoint from its connected network. An unpaired anchor is not separately charged by this setting; chunk-loading fees are additional.
Keep chunks loaded
When enabled, paired endpoints request their own and target chunks. Disabling only blocks new holds; existing holds remain until the endpoint is unbound or removed.
Extra chunk-loading drain per end (FE/s)
Charged for each end hold actually owned by an endpoint, usually two. Endpoints sharing a chunk are still charged separately. Set to 0 to waive only this extra fee, not the endpoint operating drain.
msg.rswirelesscrafting.bridge.unpaid: Insufficient power. Link paused; existing chunk holds remain. Check power and connection requirements.
item.rswirelesscrafting.wireless_configu: Copies settings from supported RS blocks; paste singly or in bulk to blocks of the same type.
With no stored settings, right-click a supported RS block to copy its settings.
With stored settings, right-click a block of the same type to paste; sneak-right-click to apply to nearby blocks of that type.

msg.rswirelesscrafting.config_card.wrong: Block type mismatch. Paste to a block of the same type.

No targets set. Right-click to open and place items in the left slots.

gui.rswirelesscrafting.monitor_rule_tool:
Current rule: %s

gui.rswirelesscrafting.monitor_target_to:

block.rswirelesscrafting.wireless_energy: Draws energy from the bound supply network into its buffer, then supplies the adjacent local RS network.
Place against the network needing power. Use the Wireless Connector to right-click a supply network block, then right-click this block to bind.
Buffer capacity: %s FE (not the current stored energy).
Base link fee: %s FE/s, scaled by distance or the interdimensional multiplier and drawn from the supply network.
Redstone stops receiving and pauses the link fee; stored buffer energy is retained.
msg.rswirelesscrafting.energy_receiver.b: Bound to the supply access point.
msg.rswirelesscrafting.energy_receiver.a: Supply access point recorded. Right-click the Wireless Energy Receiver with the Wireless Connector to bind.
msg.rswirelesscrafting.energy_receiver.o: Link disconnected. Check both networks, power, permissions and chunk loading.
text.autoconfig.rswirelesscrafting.optio: Wireless Energy Receiver
Draws energy from the bound supply network through a buffer to supply the adjacent local RS network.
Enable the energy receiver
When off, receivers stop receiving and supplying energy and pause the link fee; stored buffer energy is retained.
Buffer capacity (FE)
Internal buffer capacity, not the current stored energy. Only energy actually stored in the buffer can supply the local network.
Base link fee (FE/s)
Base link fee drawn from the bound supply network. Scaled by distance in the same dimension, or by the interdimensional multiplier across dimensions.
Shows network energy, capacity, net rate and estimated time to empty.
Place against an RS network block to read that network automatically.
Remote monitoring: use the Wireless Connector to right-click an RS network block, then right-click this block to bind.
msg.rswirelesscrafting.energy_monitor.an: Access point recorded. Right-click the Energy Monitor with the Wireless Connector to bind.
msg.rswirelesscrafting.energy_monitor.un: No network reading. Place against an RS network block, or use the Wireless Connector to record an access point and right-click this block to bind; check permissions and chunk loading.
msg.rswirelesscrafting.energy_monitor.lo: An adjacent network is available. No binding needed for local monitoring.
msg.rswirelesscrafting.energy_monitor.no: Not estimated (nonnegative net rate or zero stored energy)
msg.rswirelesscrafting.energy_monitor.st: Network energy %s / %s FE - Net rate %s FE/s - Estimated time to empty (seconds): %s
text.autoconfig.rswirelesscrafting.optio: Energy Monitor
Reads network energy, capacity and net rate, and estimates time to empty.
Enable the energy monitor
When off, monitors stop reading networks and drawing operating energy, and show a disconnected state.
Continuous drain (FE/s)
Continuous energy drawn from the monitored network while taking readings.
Low-energy threshold (%)
Lights the warning when stored energy as a percentage of capacity is at or below this threshold, or capacity is zero.
Sample interval (ticks)
Net rate sampling interval. At 20 ticks/s, 20 ticks means one sample per second.

block.rswirelesscrafting.smart_sorter.ra: Transfer budget: %s batches/s (amount also depends on the container).
block.rswirelesscrafting.smart_sorter.en: Cost per successful transfer: %s FE (currently billed per batch).
gui.rswirelesscrafting.smart_sorter.mode:
Click to switch the match mode.
By item: only items identical to the filter item.
By tag: items sharing a tag with the filter item.
text.autoconfig.rswirelesscrafting.optio: Smart Sorter
Filters by item or tag and sends network items into the container it faces.
Enable the smart sorter
When off, sorters stop transferring items and show an inactive state.
Energy per successful batch (FE)
Currently billed once per successful batch, not per item stack. The per-transfer amount limit needs verification.
Transfer budget (batches/s)
Currently allocates a transfer-batch budget, not a limit on item stacks. A batch may span slots; amount limits need verification.
Lets the local network access items and energy from another independent network, subject to transfer limits.
Use the Wireless Connector to right-click a block on the other RS network to record its access point, then right-click this block to bind.
Base link fee: %s FE/s, scaled by distance or the interdimensional multiplier and drawn from the local network.
msg.rswirelesscrafting.network_bridge.an: Access point recorded. Right-click the Network Bridge with the Wireless Connector to bind.
msg.rswirelesscrafting.network_bridge.st: Network bridge -> %s: %s - Item limit %s items/s - Energy limit %s FE/s - Link fee %s FE/s
msg.rswirelesscrafting.network_bridge.of: Link disconnected. Check both networks, power, permissions, redstone and chunk loading.
msg.rswirelesscrafting.network_bridge.cy: Bridge loop protection triggered. Check bindings, then rebind to retry.
text.autoconfig.rswirelesscrafting.optio: Network Bridge
Lets the local network access items and energy from another independent network, with configurable transfer limits.
Enable the network bridge
When off, Network Bridges stop forwarding and drawing link fees, and show a disconnected state.
Base link fee (FE/s)
Base link fee drawn from the local network. Scaled by distance in the same dimension, or by the interdimensional multiplier across dimensions.
Item transfer limit (items/s)
Maximum number of items transferred through the bridge per second.
Energy transfer limit (FE/s)
Maximum energy transferred through the bridge per second.

msg.rswirelesscrafting.link.anchor_requi: No access point recorded. Use the Wireless Connector to right-click an RS network block, then the target device to bind.
item.rswirelesscrafting.wireless_connect: Binds supported wireless devices to an RS network access point.

Hold the connector and right-click an RS network block, then a device to bind or rebind; success clears the record. With no record, right-click a bound device to unbind. Sneak-right-click only clears the record; it does not bind.
msg.rswirelesscrafting.connector.anchor_: Access point recorded: %s %s, %s, %s. Right-click the target device with the Wireless Connector to bind.
msg.rswirelesscrafting.connector.need_an: No access point recorded. Use the Wireless Connector to right-click an RS network block, then the target device to bind.
msg.rswirelesscrafting.connector.not_net: No recordable RS network found here. Check network connections and chunk loading.
msg.rswirelesscrafting.connector.no_perm: Binding not allowed. Check network permissions and target device requirements.
gui.rswirelesscrafting.terminal_offline: Not connected to a network. Manual crafting only.
text.autoconfig.rswirelesscrafting.optio: Allow offline access to the crafting terminal
Allows opening the crafting terminal without a network for manual crafting at no energy cost; network inventory is unavailable.
block.rswirelesscrafting.wireless_redsto: Transfers redstone on/off signals in pairs, including across dimensions. Any input signal produces strength 15 at the output; input strength is not preserved. Both chunks must be loaded; no automatic chunk loading.

With no access point record, sneak-right-click the input with an empty hand to record it, then another unpaired end to pair it as the output. Empty-hand sneak-right-click unbinds a paired output. With the connector held, sneak-right-click only clears the record.

msg.rswirelesscrafting.redstone_link.bou: Paired as the output. Signal transfer requires a readable input and loaded chunks.
msg.rswirelesscrafting.redstone_link.not: Recorded end unavailable. Record cleared. Check the target and chunk loading, then record the input again.
